item.content:encoded:
You're not the only one. While the writing is perfectly fine and evocative, I find the underlying concept problematic. The OTT anime fight is so at odds with the tone of the rest of SCP canon and it's got the same inherent problem as all vs. fights: it doesn't and can't pick a winner. This one has the additional problem of both characters being build built around being undefeatable and unkillable, so even if either of them came out on top it'd be an empty victory.

I understand many of the issues I have are the point and the draw of the entire piece, but they still bug me to no end. Reluctant -1 from me too.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
So, apparently it's just me, but I don't like it. Able as an unstoppable warrior god just irks me, well, Able in general irks me but generally letting him loose results in collateral damage, something that doesn't seem to happen here. A battle that epic just cannot come without serious repercussions, be it "and that's how Krakatoa blew its top" or "Godzilla is actually the Foundation's coverup", there's just no way this could play out unnoticed. Even told from
Able's view, the lack of any mention of a landscape besides slamming into rocks and making craters breaks it for me. I feel like something as simple as the occansional "as the dragon landed on a village, Able attacked again" would make it more believable.

I'm tempted to change my -1 to a no vote based on who wrote it and that everyone else likes it, but no, that feels more wrong than down voting it anyways. Sorry, but -1 from me.
